name: Fundamentals of Computers
description: Computer fundamentals, number systems, input-output devices and office tooling for new undergraduates.

name: Problem Solving with C
description: Structured programming in C: control flow, functions, arrays and pointers for first-year students.

name: Discrete and Mathematical Foundations
description: Sets, logic, relations, combinatorics and proof techniques that underpin later theory courses.

name: Data Structures Foundations
description: Introductory arrays, stacks, queues and linked lists with implementation exercises.

name: Office Tools and Communication Skills
description: Productivity tooling, technical writing and workplace communication practice.

name: Computer Architecture
description: Processor organisation, memory hierarchy, instruction cycles and input-output architecture.

name: Object-Oriented Programming with Java
description: Classes, inheritance, interfaces, collections and exception handling in Java.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Relational model, SQL, normalisation, transactions and indexing fundamentals.

name: Java and DBMS Laboratory
description: Supervised lab practice for the second-semester programming and database papers.

name: Environmental and Value Studies
description: Environmental science and value education requirement of the degree.

name: Operating Systems
description: Processes, scheduling, synchronisation, memory management and file systems.

name: Computer Networks
description: Layered network models, protocols, routing and network programming.

name: Python Programming
description: Python syntax, data structures, functions, modules and scripting practice.

name: Network and Python Laboratory
description: Supervised lab practice for the third-semester networks and Python papers.

name: Computer Hardware and Maintenance
description: Assembly, diagnostics and preventive maintenance of personal computers.

name: Software Engineering
description: Lifecycle models, requirements, design, testing and project management fundamentals.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Search, knowledge representation, reasoning and introductory machine learning.

name: Internet and Web Technologies
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTTP and server-side web programming foundations.

name: AI and Web Laboratory
description: Supervised lab practice for the fourth-semester AI and web papers.

name: Constitution and Value Studies
description: Constitutional values and professional ethics requirement of the degree.

name: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
description: Efficiency analysis, asymptotic growth, design strategies and complexity limitations.

name: Statistical Computing and R Programming
description: R environment, descriptive statistics, distributions, hypothesis testing and visualisation.

name: Software Engineering
description: Requirements engineering, UML modelling, architecture, estimation, testing and agile practice.

name: Digital Marketing
description: Search marketing, content strategy, social platforms, email, paid campaigns and web analytics.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Service and deployment models, virtualisation, storage, distributed services and cloud security. Discipline-elective option; not every student takes this paper.

name: Business Intelligence
description: Data warehousing, ETL, OLAP, dashboards, KPIs and decision support. Discipline-elective option; not every student takes this paper.

name: Cyber Security
description: Threats and vulnerabilities, access control, secure systems and cybercrime awareness.

name: Employability Skills
description: Resume building, interview technique, group discussion and workplace readiness.

name: PHP and MySQL
description: Server-side scripting with PHP and relational data access through MySQL.

name: Web Application Development
description: Full-stack web application construction: requirements, frameworks, deployment and security.

name: Artificial Intelligence and Applications
description: Applied AI: search, reasoning systems, machine learning workflows and evaluation.

name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and practical ML pipelines. Discipline-elective option.

name: Mobile Application Development
description: Android application construction, activity lifecycle, storage, sensors and publishing.

name: Software Testing
description: Test design techniques, levels of testing, automation and quality assurance.

name: Operations Research
description: Linear programming, transportation, assignment models and queuing theory.

name: Web Content Management
description: Content strategy, CMS platforms, accessibility and digital publishing workflows.

name: Internship
description: Supervised industry internship with reflective reporting.

name: Project Work
description: Final-year capstone: proposal, literature survey, implementation, testing and viva.
